verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents Git Sync for managing workspace resources programmatically, and a company comparison cites git version control, so versioning of syncs and models is supported. Approvals are mentioned only as a general governance feature, not as a review flow for automation changes, and rollback is never described. Missing for 10: explicit rollback/revert of syncs or journeys, documented change-review workflow (e.g. PR-based review of Git Sync changes), details on what Git Sync covers (journeys/audiences), independent hands-on corroboration.
